text:
Situation: Hydroxocobalamin injection from BTG International Inc. and Teva Pharmaceuticals USA, Inc. appears on FDA's shortage list as Current, first posted 2024-11-04 and updated 2026-10-19 and 2026-10-15 respectively. The shortage has been on FDA's list for 24 months as of 2026-10-21. Our inventory at Corvale East and Corvale General carries NDC 00591288830 labeled by Actavis Pharma, Inc., with the product label naming Hikma Farmaceutica (Portugal) S.A. 2705-906 Terrugem SNT as the manufacturing plant. Corvale East has 5.1 days on hand (20 vials at 3.9 vials per day). Corvale General has 18.7 days on hand (75 vials at 4 vials per day).

Why (FDA record): FDA's shortage list shows hydroxocobalamin injection from BTG International Inc. and Teva Pharmaceuticals USA, Inc. as Current, first posted 2024-11-04 and updated 2026-10-19 and 2026-10-15 respectively.

Our position: Corvale East is below the two-week target. Corvale General holds sufficient stock to support a transfer while remaining above two weeks.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 18 vials of 1000 ug/mL, 30 mL from Corvale General to Corvale East. This would leave Corvale General with 14 days and bring Corvale East to 10 days. Approval required: pharmacy director (transfer request).
2. Evaluate purchase from Xseer Pharmaceuticals. Xseer is not on FDA's shortage list today. Its label names no plant we could place. Approval required: buyer.

Not recommended: No other actions at this time.
